leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a backpressure detection mechanism using stream buffer states
Construct a producer control system that responds to consumer readiness
Apply flow control logic to pause and resume data transmission
Configure event listeners for drain events to manage backpressure
Initialize buffer monitoring to track data accumulation
Integrate backpressure awareness into existing data production pipelines
Manipulate write operations based on stream buffer capacity
